patch.value: Release timeout asks for workflow approval after automatic approval succeeded

Replace the vendored Daily Release with the pinned pm-ops caller. Track approval diagnosis, durable candidate continuation, and the release-check failure reported by the latest scheduled run. https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/issues/84

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Reproduced the inline Bash sticky flag with one pending read followed by a verified empty read. The legacy timeout still labels approval required. Linked hosted jobs show completed approvals followed by queued or running checks, and the retry replaced the same tree with a new commit. Plan: delegate to the released canonical workflow, retain owner approval and the daily minute, and reconcile durable candidates hourly.

value.text: Revert proof: restoring only the vendored release.yml failed five of nine caller and CI contract tests. Restoring the caller passed those contracts. The pinned pm-ops 2026.11.22 mocked continuation, adapter and restart suites passed 128 of 128 tests, including current approval and settling diagnosis, failed reads, protected exact-head merge, and the pending candidate held beyond the previous deadline. The same tree and parent were confirmed for the two historical release PR heads. The recovery-race evidence is tracked in pm-ado-resolution-recovery-race.

value.text: Review follow-up on b4af57d. PM_OPS_OFFLINE=1 makes the real-checkout attestation test fail while 7 publisher-fixture tests pass. The launcher reports unverified-offline because the bundled snapshot lacks v2026.11.22. With the flag absent the suite passes 8 of 8. The source check makes one fetch at present, so one transient failure rejects all shared assertions. Plan: keep fixture tests offline, require live checkout verification in explicit attestation, and retry transient source fetches at the same SHA.
